stories.title: ECP takes notice of alleged code violation by Attaullah Tarar ahead of NA-77 by-poll
stories.brief: According to a press release issued by the ECP, the minister visited the constituency by helicopter and addressed a campaign event for Rashid Basheer Virk, who is contesting elections in National Assembly constituency NA-77 (Gujranwala-I).

stories.title: Eisenkot chosen over Netanyahu to form Israel’s next government
stories.brief: Israel's president asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form the next gov't over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

stories.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
stories.brief: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

stories.title: Govt shifts gears to rev up EV adoption
stories.brief: The government's new Automotive Industry Policy aims to gradually reduce vehicle prices, while transforming the auto sector into a competitive, export-oriented manufacturing industry through greater localisation, improved safety standards and promotion of electric vehicles.

stories.title: Netanyahu's reign ends as Eisenkot gets nod to form govt
stories.brief: Building on a months-long naval blockade on Iran, the US military said on Saturday it is launching a task force to help crack down on Tehran's movement of advanced weapons and other sanctioned material over its land borders and through the Caspian Sea.

stories.title: BISP audit reveals Rs25.7 billion irregularities
stories.brief: An audit of the Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP) for 2024-25 has exposed widespread irregularities, including payments to government employees, pensioners and ineligible beneficiaries, duplicate educational stipends and serious flaws in beneficiary records.

stories.title: PTI rift puts TTAP organisation plan on hold
stories.brief: In mid-October, TTAP had told The Express Tribune that, with PTI's backing, it planned to establish its own political arm and develop a formal organisational structure at the provincial level.

stories.title: SC acquits mentally unsound blasphemy convicts
stories.brief: "The report of the eight- and nine-member Board of Certification dated 31.08.2023 and 18.09.2025 establishes that the appellants suffer from bipolar disorder.

stories.title: US ‘Task Force Iron Gate’ in the works to restrict Iranian land commerce alongside naval blockade
stories.brief: After a months-long naval blockade on Iran, the US military has announced the establishment of a task force to bolster Washington’s efforts to restrict Tehran’s movement of advanced weapons systems and other sanctioned material across its land borders and the Caspian Sea.

stories.title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be White House press secretary
stories.brief: Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO says he will meet with the US president on Monday to discuss the offer.

stories.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
stories.brief: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

stories.title: Israel’s president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government
stories.brief: Isaac Herzog formally gives Gadi Eisenkot 28 days to secure 61 Knesset seats and replace Netanyahu as prime minister.

stories.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
stories.brief: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.(Image credit: Ariel Schalit)

stories.title: Paraguay’s ousted president appears before prosecutors after impeachment
stories.brief: Former Paraguayan President Santiago Pena has appeared before prosecutors.

stories.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
stories.brief: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.(Image credit: Federico Parra)

stories.title: Standing in the way of slop bowls: the woman blocking food delivery robots
stories.brief: Tucked away in a dingy alley, opposite a garage called Patriot Parking, 78-year-old Carolyn Marvin is laying out some ground rules for a robot-disrupting expedition. Once a suitable target is identified, we will follow it to a busy sidewalk and Marvin will stand in front of the robot, blocking its way.

stories.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
stories.brief: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

stories.title: Global stocks fall amid ‘big worries over AI’ after Democrats’ midterms triumph
stories.brief: The investor sentiment then reached London, where the market was, at one stage, poised for its worst day since March.

stories.title: Usman Khawaja denies throwing 'anyone under the bus' with comments about Australia's 2018 ball-tampering scandal
stories.brief: Usman Khawaja insisted on Sunday he did not “throw anyone under the bus” by claiming the entire Australian team was in on the 2018 “Sandpapergate” plot and defended taking eight years to go public.
